content.rationale: Capture is where S5-bracket's read-run-read protocol, S5-lifecycle's which-invocations-bracket rule, and G-capture's term for that protocol meet; this check brackets real jj operations in a scratch repo and pins that a bracket keeps its (pre, post) pair with the position at its post-boundary, that the two reads sit on either side of the run while the run's own value passes through untouched, that pairs stack in run order, that a missing file brackets from empty, that a failed read aborts before the run and an absent binary is a spawn failure while a refused append is carried with its reason, and that capture brackets unconditionally — a run that fails, or moves nothing at all, still closes its bracket — so which invocations bracket stays the lifecycle table's call. It pulls in serde_json and the validator the append chain needs, so it is a crate of its own; the JSON layer is I1-serde's and the validator I1-schema's.
